messages:
alex: Heads-up: drafting a proposal for 'soft-failover' routing for private tenants with egress restrictions. TL;DR: allow model-variant fallback only if same allowed-region and clear egress_intent header; emit telemetry + operator approval flow. Ping for opinions.
rachel: What's soft-failover? fallback that doesn't cross egress boundaries?
alex: Yes. If tenant disallows outbound to regions X, we shouldn't route to model servers in those regions. But sometimes compatible variant exists in allowed region. Soft-failover = prefer same-region variant, then fallback to cached responses / degraded mode, not cross-region unless explicit tenant opt-in.
tariq: Sounds good. Concern: how do we detect decision at control plane vs runtime? we need API change.
alex: ```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  x-redwood-egress-intent: "cross-region|local-only|allow-telemetry"
  x-redwood-tenant-id: "acct-123"
```
margo: I don't love new header for security — that can be spoofed if misused. Maybe enforce in control plane auth token claims?
kevin: Agree with margo. Put egress policy in JWT claims: egress_policy: ['eu','us-west'] and validate at gateway.
alex: Good point. Proposal updated: gateway enforces region whitelist from tenant subscription & injects signed egress-intent to internal routing header 'x-rw-signed-egress'.
rachel: Telemetry: we need counters for 'soft-failover-triggered', 'hard-failover' and latency impact per-model-variant. Also sample traces to link request->fallback.
tariq: Can we avoid perf hit? Suggest sampling 1% traces and increment counters for all requests. Also add metric 'egress_blocked' for policy violations.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout canary started for 2 tenants :rocket:.
margo: Console UX: show 'egress-risk' badge on tenant page + switch to allow per-tenant override with audit log. Also add 'simulate' mode to preview soft-failover decisions.
alex: Added UI mock sketch in figma: https://www.figma.com/proto/placeholder — show idea. Suggest adding operator approval for first cross-region fallback per tenant.
kevin: API debate: do we allow model variant fallback with quantized variant? There might be quality regressions. Add 'fallback_quality_threshold' per tenant.
rachel: Agree. Also need alerting: if fallback rate > 0.5% triggered -> notify SRE and account owner.
tariq: Edge-case: offline private control plane behind NAT — how do we get telemetry out? We should support batched telemetry via Kinesis/private aggregator.
alex: Right. Implementation note: for private deployments put telemetry sink configurable: 'endpoint://internal' or 's3://bucket' with signed delivery. Add 'egress_decision_logs' retention 90d.
margo: Docs: add sample policy DSL:
```
{
  "allow_regions": ["us-east-1"],
  "fallback": {
     "allow_cross_region": false,
     "allowed_variant_tags": ["v1-quant","v1-fp16"],
     "quality_threshold": 0.85
  }
}
```
rachel: :thumbsup: That looks good.
tariq: Next steps: sync with infra and security. I'll open an RFC and slot for Wed sync. Also want a short e2e test plan.
alex: Thanks. RFC link: /rfc/soft-failover-egress (placeholder). I'll follow up with a proto PR for header/jwt change.
